verdict.rationale: Slate installs as a global npm CLI and documents automation-friendly building blocks: `--dangerously-skip-permissions`/`--yolo` to bypass approval prompts, plus config-file permissions (allow/ask/deny) and model defaults in `slate.json`. However, all documented usage is an interactive TUI (sessions, hotkeys, onboarding prompts), and nothing shows a non-interactive or headless run mode or a CI integration. Missing for 10: a documented headless/non-interactive invocation (e.g. a prompt-in, output-out mode), CI setup guidance or examples, non-interactive auth/onboarding, and hands-on corroboration of CI use.
